title: Why It's So Hard To Succeed - The Survivorship Bias (animated)
summary: Animated explainer of survivorship bias: media show winners and hide failures, so aspirants overestimate their odds and copy habits that failures shared too.

assertions.quote: overestimate our chances of succeeding, because failures are ignored.
have been applying those "5 surprising habits of the successful people", but are not successful.

verdicts.note: Selecting on the outcome makes habit correlations uninformative; base-rate failure data for founders and creators bears this out.

Model: the talent of the most successful agent across 10000 runs is Gaussian with mean 0.667 and sd 0.09, barely above the population mean of 0.6, so top performers are not distinguished by their traits but by luck; habits are not modelled.

assertions.quote: other elements at play here, one for example: pure luck.
